# Attio | Product Overview

Attio is an AI native and configurable data model CRM, emphasizing "agentic revenue" and automatic collation of relational data. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
